hunts.name: Rat Cellars
hunts.description: Damp cellars full of rats. The classic first hunt.

hunts.name: Spider Nest
hunts.description: Spiders in numbers, fast and poor in loot.

hunts.name: Troll Hills
hunts.description: Slow, dim trolls that hoard whatever they grab.

hunts.name: Swamp Troll Cave
hunts.description: Swamp trolls: slow, stubborn, and they hoard the shallows' finds.

hunts.name: Orc Camp
hunts.description: Orcs in armed packs.

hunts.name: Folda Icefields
hunts.description: Frost trolls in numbers, winter wolves on the snow, and polar bears that hit far harder.

hunts.name: Bone Crypt
hunts.description: Skeletons that hit harder than they look.

hunts.name: Rotworm Caves
hunts.description: Sluggish rotworms that take a beating.

hunts.name: Dwarf Mines
hunts.description: Stout, well-armed dwarfs defending every tunnel.

hunts.name: Minotaur Maze
hunts.description: Disciplined, armored minotaurs worth the fight.

hunts.name: Gloomy Poacher Caves
hunts.description: Gloom wolves hit hard; ghost wolves dodge a third of steel — bring fire or holy.

hunts.name: Amazon Camp
hunts.description: Amazons throw knives; valkyries hurl spears and charge.

hunts.name: Dark Cathedral
hunts.description: Smugglers, bandits and warriors, with assassins' poisoned stars and life-draining dark monks.

hunts.name: Ghoul Graveyard
hunts.description: Ghouls that claw through anything for a meal.

hunts.name: Rorc Camp
hunts.description: Rorcs hit hard, heal and sprint; energy barely scratches them — use earth or death.

hunts.name: Yalahar Elf Quarter
hunts.description: Elves with bows; deeper, scouts with poison and arcanists with energy and death bolts.

hunts.name: Tarantula Burrows
hunts.description: Fast, vicious tarantulas. Not for beginners.

hunts.name: Scarab Tombs
hunts.description: Armored scarabs pouring from the sand, spitting venom.

hunts.name: Venore Swamp
hunts.description: Poison, mud and rooting golems; treelings drain mana. Earth is wasted — bring fire.

hunts.name: Tortoise Shore
hunts.description: Armored tortoises and blood crabs; thornbacks snap hard enough to crack plate.

hunts.name: Plagued Quarter
hunts.description: Mutated humans in packs, spitting poison.

hunts.name: Cyclop Hills
hunts.description: Cyclopes that swing first. Bring armor worth denting.

hunts.name: Burial Chambers
hunts.description: Slow mummies with a withering touch up close.

hunts.name: Hell Gate
hunts.description: Floating bonelords raking you with elemental bolts from range.

hunts.name: Orc Fortress
hunts.description: The whole orc war host: grunts outside, warriors, shamans, riders, berserkers and the warlord within.

hunts.name: Yalahar Green Djinn Fortress
hunts.description: Green djinn: fire, death bursts and energy. They resist fire and energy — use cold or holy.

hunts.name: Yalahar Blue Djinn Fortress
hunts.description: Blue djinn: same volleys as the green, but cold and plain steel are the way in.

hunts.name: Carlin Corym Cave
hunts.description: Corym charlatans above, club-slinging skirmishers below, vanguards with earth waves deepest.

hunts.name: Magician Cults
hunts.description: Cultists draining at range; the enlightened heal, root you and summon undead.

hunts.name: Elder Forest
hunts.description: An old wood grown dark over three floors of root and hollow.

hunts.name: Drefia
hunts.description: A catacomb of skeletons, ghouls and demon skeletons, with necromancers, priestesses and blood priests calling ghouls, draining mana and healing.

hunts.name: Braindeath Caves
hunts.description: Bonelords outside, elder bonelords deeper, braindeaths in the deepest chambers.

hunts.name: Frost Mines
hunts.description: Ice golems that hit like falling rock and spit shards from afar.

hunts.name: Lizard Steppe
hunts.description: Lizard patrols with snakecharmers behind; one in eight is a caiman or a zaogun with a 375 beam.

hunts.name: Brimstone Cave
hunts.description: Brimstone bugs burn and drain, lancer beetles spit poison, wailing widows scream life away.

hunts.name: Dragon Lair
hunts.description: True dragons: ancient, armored and rich.

hunts.name: Vampire Crypt
hunts.description: Vampires that drain and heal; viscounts burst bats and death bombs; brides cast from seven tiles.

hunts.name: Mutated Cave
hunts.description: Poison-breathing mutated bats and pouncing tigers, both self-healing.

hunts.name: Yalahar Bog
hunts.description: Bog raiders: earth bolts, a slowing mist, life drain and self-healing. Only fire really hurts them.

hunts.name: Giant Spider Cavern
hunts.description: Giant spiders with crushing fangs and clouds of venom.

hunts.name: The Deep
hunts.description: Deeplings: spellsingers freeze and drain, guards throw and heal, sharks in every pool.

hunts.name: Hero Fortress
hunts.description: Heroes that meet every charge blade-first and punish retreat with arrows.

hunts.name: Wyrm Caverns
hunts.description: Quick, self-healing wyrms with a cone of raw energy.

hunts.name: Zao Stronghold
hunts.description: Legionnaires and dragon priests outside; high guards within, and drakens breathing fire.

hunts.name: Grimvale Warrens
hunts.description: Werebadgers: earth at your feet, life drain and self-healing.

hunts.name: Rathleton Minotaur Camp
hunts.description: Six minotaur ranks: energy beams, roots, burst arrows, mana drain, whirling blades and ground stomps.

hunts.name: Grimvale Dens
hunts.description: Charging wereboars and werebears that tear life out of everyone close.

hunts.name: Dragon Lord Peak
hunts.description: Dragon lords: fireballs and waves long before you close.

hunts.name: Factory Quarter
hunts.description: War golems: a 550 melee, energy strikes from seven tiles, an electrifying touch, self-healing and haste.

hunts.name: Corrupted Terraces
hunts.description: Lizard chosen: the hardest lizard blow, plus venom cones, bursts and a beam.

hunts.name: Hyaena Lairs
hunts.description: Werehyaenas hurling rocks and breathing death; shamans do the same from range and drop the earth on groups.

hunts.name: Lion Sanctum
hunts.description: Werelions and werelionesses with holy strikes and self-healing; white lions explode on everyone close.

hunts.name: Behemoth Quarry
hunts.description: Behemoths that charge, hit like falling rock and throw it when you back off.

hunts.name: Magician Quarter
hunts.description: Fast, hard-hitting hellspawns that set the ground alight.

hunts.name: Banuta Ruins
hunts.description: Hydras spitting ice and venom, medusas draining at range, guardians immune to every element.

hunts.name: Seacrest Caves
hunts.description: Fast seacrest serpents: ice waves, life drain and self-healing.

hunts.name: Draken Walls
hunts.description: Draken warmasters with halberd and fire breath; spellweavers with fire, energy, earth and healing.

hunts.name: Haunted Cellar
hunts.description: Ripper spectres: every attack bursts from their own tile; they heal and resist steel — bring fire.

hunts.name: Goroma Serpent Caves
hunts.description: Serpent spawns paralyse, drain and heal; medusas beam eight tiles. Earth is wasted — use fire or energy.

hunts.name: Asura Palace
hunts.description: Dawnfire and midnight asuras with death and energy, both paralyzing for 15s; the frost flower hits hardest, hellspawns hold the stairs.

hunts.name: Haunted Temple
hunts.description: Gazer spectres: fire from seven tiles, life drain up close. Resist fire and steel; ice works.

hunts.name: Lower Roshamuul
hunts.description: Frazzlemaws and silencers in tight mixed packs.

hunts.name: Haunted Tomb
hunts.description: Burster spectres: ice from range, then life drain. Immune to physical — elemental damage only.

hunts.name: Halls of the Reaper
hunts.description: Grim reapers: less flesh than a demon, and the hardest beam in the world.

hunts.name: Infernal Gate
hunts.description: Demons: siege-engine blows, fireballs and fast self-healing.

hunts.name: Falcon's Eye
hunts.description: Falcon knights up close, paladins with spear, bolt and energy volleys.

hunts.name: Falcon Bastion
hunts.description: The Falcon keep floor by floor: knights on every stair, paladins on the walls.

hunts.name: Lion Bastion
hunts.description: Usurper knights with an ice beam and self-healing, archers with burst arrows and death shots from range, warlocks with death and ice chains and avalanches. Weak to death, resistant to ice.

hunts.name: Cobra Bastion
hunts.description: Cobra assassins with a five-tile beam, scouts with earth arrows, viziers with heavy death bolts. Immune to earth.

hunts.name: Hell Hub
hunts.description: Demons, hasted vexclaws, ground-draining grimeleeches and hellflayers, the hardest hitters anywhere.

hunts.name: Marapur Naga
hunts.description: Naga archers with death chains from range, warriors draining life around them, makaras with stone showers and a water wave. Weak to earth, and the nagas also to holy.

hunts.name: Catacombs
hunts.description: A single floor of burial vaults, picked over and reopened.

hunts.name: Kilmaresh Steppe
hunts.description: Sphinxes breathe fire six tiles and cast holy; lamassu hit harder and burn everything close.

hunts.name: Issavi Steppe
hunts.description: Goanna packs, fire-slinging ogres, manticores at range, sphinxes and a feral one deeper in.

hunts.name: Ice Library
hunts.description: Feathers and books throwing ice, squid wardens hitting hardest. Immune to ice, weak to fire.

hunts.name: Fire Library
hunts.description: Burning books throwing fire and hitting hardest, rage squids and guardians of tales with fire and life drain, ink blobs spitting poison. Immune to fire and weak to ice, except the blobs: immune to earth, weak to energy.
